race.comment: OCEAN TSUNAMI (5) smart Scone-trained mare who resumes with residual fitness on her side. Demolished a handy field in BM66 grade over 1700m at Scone on July 31. Gets in light with Neale's 3kg claim and fitted with the 1200m trial. Great set-up and sure to be thereabouts. HIP HIP OLE (7) lightly raced mare heading in the right direction. Stuck on well first up over the unsuitable 1200m to run a respectable third at Wagga. Ready for this tougher challenge and Keatings' 3kg claim keeps her in the picture. MAGIC MERLIN (4) deep into the prep and deserves his chance in town. Made it three wins from his last four runs when he swooped late to score over 1600m at Scone. Don't underestimate with fitness on his side. COSTALIVIN (13) lightly raced mare building a good winning CV.  Defeated inferior opposition over 1500m at Goulburn in C2 grade. Will roll forward and give plenty of cheek. CONDONE (1) going better than his recent runs suggest and worth thought. The chances don't end there.
